newsitem.title: SIERRA LEONE: Floods kill three in Sierra Leone diamond district.
newsitem.headline: Floods kill three in Sierra Leone diamond district.

text.p: Flooding has killed at least three villagers and made several hundred homeless in Sierra Leone's eastern diamond-mining district of Kono, police said on Sunday.
Saturday's flooding, which followed several days of torrential rain in the Lai Chiefdom, swept away 50 homes, drowned cattle and destroyed rice crops.
State radio said many villagers in the district had just been resettled after fleeing their homes last year because of attacks by rebels who took up arms in 1991.

The civilian government of Ahmad Tejan Kabbah, which took office in March after four years of military rule, has agreed to a truce with the rebels but differences remain over the terms of a final peace deal.
The Lai Chiefdom is the main producer in Kono of rice, a staple in the district.
